slides.headline: Think of it like a waiter
slides.body: You order food. The waiter takes your request to the kitchen and brings back exactly what you asked for.

slides.headline: Your app does the same
slides.body: Your app sends a request. The API fetches data from a server and returns exactly what your app asked for.

slides.headline: Real example: Weather apps
slides.body: When you check the weather, your app calls a weather API. It returns temperature, humidity, and forecast data instantly.
